title: AI Engineer
summary: Builds and ships LLM-powered applications: RAG systems, agents, evaluation harnesses and the serving infrastructure around them.
description: An AI Engineer designs, builds and operates production systems on top of foundation models. The role spans prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, embedding and vector-store design, agent/tool orchestration, evaluation and guardrails, plus the API and deployment layer that exposes these capabilities to users. Strong candidates show end-to-end ownership: they have taken an LLM feature from prototype to production with measurable quality metrics, latency budgets and cost controls.
responsibilities: Design and ship retrieval-augmented generation pipelines over proprietary data
Engineer prompts, tools and agent workflows for reliability at scale
Build evaluation harnesses and offline/online quality metrics for LLM features
Optimise inference latency, throughput and token cost
Expose model capabilities through well-tested backend APIs
Collaborate with product and data teams to define AI feature requirements
education: Bachelor's in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence or related field

title: Machine Learning Engineer
summary: Trains, deploys and monitors machine learning models in production, owning the pipeline from features to serving.
description: A Machine Learning Engineer turns models into reliable production services. The role covers feature engineering, model training and validation, experiment tracking, reproducible pipelines, model packaging and serving, plus monitoring for drift and degradation. Strong candidates combine solid ML fundamentals with software engineering discipline: versioned data, tested code, automated retraining and clear performance baselines.
responsibilities: Build and maintain reproducible training pipelines
Engineer features and manage datasets at scale
Deploy models as low-latency services with automated rollback
Track experiments and maintain performance baselines
Monitor production models for drift, skew and degradation
Partner with data scientists to productionise research prototypes
education: Bachelor's in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics or related field
Master's in Machine Learning or Data Science (preferred)

title: Python Developer
summary: Builds backend services, APIs and automation in Python with an emphasis on clean, tested, maintainable code.
description: A Python Developer designs and implements server-side applications: REST APIs, background workers, integrations and data-processing jobs. The role demands fluency in the Python ecosystem, relational database design, testing practice and version control workflow. Strong candidates show ownership of production services, comfort with debugging and profiling, and a track record of readable code that other engineers can extend.
responsibilities: Design and implement RESTful backend services
Model and query relational databases efficiently
Write unit and integration tests for critical paths
Review code and uphold engineering standards
Debug, profile and optimise production issues
Automate recurring workflows and data jobs
education: Bachelor's in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field

title: Full Stack Developer
summary: Owns features end to end across the browser, the API layer and the database.
description: A Full Stack Developer delivers complete product features: responsive user interfaces, the backend APIs behind them and the data model underneath. The role spans modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks, server-side development, database design, authentication, and deployment. Strong candidates demonstrate breadth without shallowness — they can reason about render performance and query plans in the same day.
responsibilities: Build responsive, accessible user interfaces
Design and implement backend APIs and data models
Integrate third-party services and authentication providers
Write automated tests across the stack
Deploy and monitor features in production
Collaborate with designers on UX implementation
education: Bachelor's in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related field

title: Data Scientist
summary: Turns data into decisions through statistical analysis, experimentation and predictive modelling.
description: A Data Scientist frames business problems as analytical questions, builds the datasets to answer them, and communicates findings that change decisions. The role covers exploratory analysis, statistical inference, experiment design, predictive modelling and visualisation. Strong candidates pair technical depth in statistics and Python/SQL with the communication skill to make stakeholders act on a result.
responsibilities: Perform exploratory analysis to surface patterns and opportunities
Design and evaluate experiments and A/B tests
Build predictive models and validate them rigorously
Create dashboards and visualisations for stakeholders
Translate business questions into analytical frameworks
Present findings and recommendations to non-technical audiences
education: Bachelor's in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics or related field
Master's or PhD in a quantitative discipline (preferred)

title: Business Analyst
summary: Bridges business needs and technical delivery through requirements, analysis and stakeholder alignment.
description: A Business Analyst elicits and documents requirements, analyses processes and data, and keeps stakeholders and delivery teams aligned. The role covers requirement gathering, process mapping, gap analysis, reporting, and support for UAT and rollout. Strong candidates combine analytical rigour in SQL and spreadsheets with the communication and facilitation skills to drive consensus across teams.
responsibilities: Elicit, document and prioritise business requirements
Map current-state processes and identify improvement opportunities
Build reports and dashboards that track business KPIs
Facilitate workshops and align cross-functional stakeholders
Write user stories and acceptance criteria for delivery teams
Coordinate user acceptance testing and rollout
education: Bachelor's in Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, IT or related field
